verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs describe a free, fully featured Sandbox in which all Plaid API and Link functionality is supported and unlimited test Items can be created. A Sandbox-only /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint generates tokens for arbitrary institution IDs, products and test credentials, and the Quickstart app helps run this locally, so linking and data retrieval can be exercised before touching real accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific test credentials and test institutions, Sandbox-specific simulation of error states (the SDK try/catch snippets show generic error handling only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end Sandbox experience.
